circle_back.definition: To return to a topic later. Often used to postpone a decision.
circle_back.example: Let us circle back to the budget question after lunch.

culture_shock.definition: The disorientation you feel when the everyday rules of a place stop matching the ones you grew up with.
culture_shock.example: Culture shock hit me the week I could not find a supermarket open after six.

er_venting.definition: Putting a feeling into words as a way of getting the body back down.
er_venting.example: The venting helped her settle, and the other person had heard none of it.

flour.definition: Wheat grain ground into a fine powder. It is the main part of the bread.
flour.example: Flour is made from wheat at the mill.

google_effect.definition: The tendency to forget information that is easy to find online, while remembering how to find it.

si_substance.definition: Matter of a definite kind and composition.
